rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cites as metadata document
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The citing entity cites the cited entity as being the container of metadata describing the citing entity.
rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: This is used in combination with [OWL2 punning](https://www.w3.org/TR/owl2-new-features/#F12:_Punning) to characterise the type of a relation ("HasMetadata") as an instance of `datacite:QualifiedRelation` via the property `datacite:hasRelationCharacterization`.
